limitations: A candle-open replay cannot reproduce market-order latency or slippage.
Delayed execution changes the stop distance and therefore re-applies the frozen 1%-2% risk-distance gate.
Gross returns exclude fees at user request.

protocol.entry: market at next 15-minute open after one closed confirmation candle
protocol.exit: retained structural stop; 5% at 0.5R and 95% runner at 2R
protocol.money: client-selected current-equity margin; audited at 3%, fixed 10x
